title: Smiling Little Girls on Wooden Lawn Swing, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: Two young girls sit side-by-side smiling within a wooden A-frame lawn swing glider in a sun-dappled backyard. Surrounded by trees and grass, the children are dressed in lightweight summer clothing and wear mid-century hairstyles—one with wavy hair and the other with a classic bob and bangs. The wooden lawn glider was an iconic staple of mid-20th-century American domestic leisure, capturing a peaceful, everyday moment of childhood.
